memberdef.argsstring: (TBAAStructTagNode BaseTag, TBAAStructTagNode SubobjectTag, const MDNode *CommonType, const MDNode **GenericTag, bool &MayAlias)
memberdef.name: mayBeAccessToSubobjectOf

briefdescription.para: Return true if for two given accesses, one of the accessed objects may be a subobject of the other.

detaileddescription.para: The BaseTag and SubobjectTag parameters describe the accesses to the base object and the subobject respectively. CommonType must be the metadata node describing the common type of the accessed objects. On return, MayAlias is set to true iff these accesses may alias and Generic, if not null, points to the most generic access tag for the given two.
